title: Judge leniency as IV for incarceration on recidivism
research_question: Does incarceration reduce or increase recidivism, using random assignment of criminal cases to lenient vs. strict judges as an instrument?
data_description: Cross-sectional data on 500 criminal defendants. Variables: y (recidivism within 3 years, binary), x (incarcerated binary), z (judge leniency index — leave-one-out mean incarceration rate for judge), controls (offense type, prior record, age). Exclusion: judge assignment affects recidivism only through incarceration decision.
